integrity: The mathematical statements are supported by proofs and exact rational checks. Independent external validation has not been performed; unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
scientific_limitations: General convex-body comparison assumes central symmetry and cone-boundary sampling; ordinary physical surface measure agrees only in particular bodies such as cubes. Cubic formula assumes unweighted coordinate cube and affine projection. Results do not cover higher polynomial degrees, asymmetric bodies, or arbitrary surface-area sampling.
title: Cone-boundary affine least squares is strictly more stable than volume least squares, with a sharp hypercube gap
